value.rationale: This is a complete naturally motivated edge-general-position complex census for all cycles, not a scalar-optimum repetition. It determines every feasible edge placement count and every irredundant/maximal placement count, and reveals a sharp structural purity exception: among n>=6 only C_7 has all maximal configurations of maximum size. The known maximum gp_e(C_n)=4 does not imply these facts; graph placement and greediness questions require exactly this finer information.
